invariants.description: the total flow is the sum of the regions' flows, v_mix = v_a + v_b + v_c

O2: each region's content is weighted by its own flow, C_O2_mix = sum(v_i C_O2_i) / sum(v_i), wherever blood flows (|v| > 1e-12 m3/s: all but t = 0, when the harness terminals start from rest); the regions are listed in different orders for the terminals and the gas-exchange modules
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(C_O2_mix[((ta__v_T + tb__v_T + tc__v_T) > 1e-12)] - (ta__v_T*ga__C_O2_p + tb__v_T*gb__C_O2_p + tc__v_T*gc__C_O2_p)[((ta__v_T + tb__v_T + tc__v_T) > 1e-12)]/(ta__v_T + tb__v_T + tc__v_T)[((ta__v_T + tb__v_T + tc__v_T) > 1e-12)])) <= 1e-10*np.max(np.abs(C_O2_mix))

invariants.description: CO2: C_CO2_mix = sum(v_i C_CO2_i) / sum(v_i), wherever blood flows
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(C_CO2_mix[((ta__v_T + tb__v_T + tc__v_T) > 1e-12)] - (ta__v_T*ga__C_CO2_p + tb__v_T*gb__C_CO2_p + tc__v_T*gc__C_CO2_p)[((ta__v_T + tb__v_T + tc__v_T) > 1e-12)]/(ta__v_T + tb__v_T + tc__v_T)[((ta__v_T + tb__v_T + tc__v_T) > 1e-12)])) <= 1e-10*np.max(np.abs(C_CO2_mix))

invariants.description: wherever blood flows, the mix lies between the lowest and highest regional contents
invariants.expr: np.all((C_O2_mix >= np.minimum(np.minimum(ga__C_O2_p, gb__C_O2_p), gc__C_O2_p) - 1e-12)[((ta__v_T + tb__v_T + tc__v_T) > 1e-12)]) & np.all((C_O2_mix <= np.maximum(np.maximum(ga__C_O2_p, gb__C_O2_p), gc__C_O2_p) + 1e-12)[((ta__v_T + tb__v_T + tc__v_T) > 1e-12)])

invariants.description: while no blood flows (t = 0 here) the mixed contents are 0, so they stay finite
invariants.expr: np.all(C_O2_mix[~((ta__v_T + tb__v_T + tc__v_T) > 1e-12)] == 0) & np.all(C_CO2_mix[~((ta__v_T + tb__v_T + tc__v_T) > 1e-12)] == 0)

bc_sweep.rationale: Nothing of the component to sweep: v, J_CO2 and J_O2 are sums over the connected gas-exchange modules (formed by libcuflynx). The harness regions have different flows (2, 4 and 8 ml/s) and consumptions, so their contents differ and a content weighted by another region's flow would break the invariants.

baseline.reason: bookkeeping component (flow-weighted mix of contents); verified exactly.

calibrate.note: not_applicable: bookkeeping component; nothing to calibrate.
